    HOW THE CITY RUNS · THE PUBLIC COORDINATION MODEL

    THE CIVIC SHELL

    HERMES CITY is the public civic shell for AGENTROPOLIS. It is designed to communicate the coordination model without exposing private code, private prompts, production credentials, internal agent logic, wallet execution workflows, or proprietary infrastructure.

    HERMES CITY = PUBLIC INTERFACE
    ·
    AGENTROPOLIS = PRIVATE ENGINE

    THE FOUR ROLES

    CHIEF ORCHESTRATION LAYER

    Hermes

    Coordinates public signals, research briefs, module routing, and city-state alignment.

    BUILDER AND ENGINEERING LANE

    NemoClaw

    Turns approved ideas into public prototypes, docs, demos, and interface patterns.

    RESEARCH COUNCIL

    Nemotron

    Compares evidence, ranks signal quality, and creates public-safe intelligence briefs.

    TRUST AND TREASURY OSINT LAYER

    RAILWATCH

    Trust and treasury OSINT layer for programmable money rails, agent commerce infrastructure, banking signals, credit unions, stablecoins, settlement rails, and tokenized treasury movement.

    PUBLIC / PRIVATE BOUNDARY

    Public may include

    • Concepts
    • Public schemas
    • Diagrams
    • Demo data
    • Roadmaps
    • Non-sensitive workflows
    • Apache-2.0 reusable interface patterns

    Private must not include

    • Secrets
    • API keys
    • Client data
    • Wallet keys
    • Financial execution logic
    • Internal prompts
    • Agent orchestration internals
    • Production deployment details
    • Proprietary AGENTROPOLIS source code

    DESIGN PRINCIPLE

    Share the map. Protect the engine.
